original.scope: 唯一原Python fence；工具guard禁網路、子程序、外部寫入；原始fence與原stdout保留於本節persistent artifacts。

runs.name: exercise
runs.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -c 'from pathlib import Path; exec(compile(Path("docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/18.5-exercise-code.txt").read_bytes(), "18.5-exercise-code.txt", "exec"))' > docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/18.5-exercise-stdout.txt 2> docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/18.5-exercise-stderr.txt
runs.execution_note: exit_code=0 是本task實際工具回傳；此處保存當次命令與既有stdout，不聲稱重新執行正式GPU排程。
